pages.text: Welcome to Explorer's Eve! Take a moment to admire your spawn area. It probably won't last long.$(br2)This modpack is balanced around summoning the Wither Storm as soon as possible, however, you're free to explore as much as you'd like before doing so. When you're ready, locate a structure nearby where you spawned.

This structure, typically a rundown house, will contain a typical Wither spawning structure on the roof with a Command Block replacing the center piece of soul sand. Place the last skull on top, then $(thing)run$(). It will quickly awake and chase you, so do your best to $(thing)outmaneuver it$()! If you can lure it behind a tall tree or building to get out of sight, you can escape before it evolves too much. If you take too long, $(thing)punch$() its head and hope for the best.

As pretty as the Twilight Forest is, it lacks critical resources. You'll never find diamonds here, and there's no way to seriously fight back against the Wither Storm.$(br2)Once you've gathered some basic gear, you'll want to get to the $(thing)Overworld$() to gear up and progress further. This requires a portal, which in turn requires an $(item)Echo Shard$(), a magical catalyst with interdimensional resonance.

To get your first shards, good places to search include a white-roofed $(thing)Lich Tower$(), a rare $(thing)Quest Grove$(), the glacier's revamped $(thing)Aurora Palace$(), a swampy and extensive $(thing)Labyrinth$(), a buried $(thing)Stronghold$() in the dark forest, or the dangerous $(thing)Fire Swamp$().$(br2)These options aren't all equal, so if one seems too rough, it might be best to retreat and try another.

Once you've found an $(item)Echo Shard$(), constructing the portal is simple! Dig a shallow pool in the grass and line the edges, not including the corners, with flowers! Drop the $(item)Echo Shard$() in the water, and the portal will open!$(br2)Also, note that you $(thing)cannot leave the Twilight Forest until the Wither Storm is spawned$().
